settings_outputs_purpose: Let other apps use your index: a Torznab address and key for Prowlarr, Sonarr and Radarr, and a file of your torrents for bitmagnet.
settings_outputs_torznab_intro: Prowlarr, Sonarr and Radarr can search Lodestar as a Torznab indexer. Each app needs this address and its own key.
settings_outputs_torznab_url_help: Paste it into the app's URL field and leave API Path as /api. If the app runs on another computer or in another container, use the address it reaches Lodestar at instead. In Prowlarr, add a Generic Torznab indexer. In Sonarr and Radarr, add a Torznab indexer.
settings_outputs_torznab_categories: In Sonarr, add categories 5000 and 5045 to its defaults, or shows without a resolution in their name and 4K shows aren't found.
settings_outputs_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
settings_outputs_keys_help: Use one key per app, so you can revoke one without breaking the others. Lodestar keeps only a hash of each key: its secret is shown once, when you create or regenerate it.
settings_outputs_keys_empty: No Torznab keys yet. Create one for each app that should search Lodestar.
settings_outputs_keys_wider_help: This key can do more than Torznab. A key with only Torznab access is safer: manage it in Security.
settings_outputs_keys_security: Other keys and access are in Security → API keys.
settings_outputs_new_name_help: Name the key after the app that will use it.
settings_outputs_create_body: The key lets {name} search Lodestar, and nothing else. Its secret is shown once, right after.
settings_outputs_regenerate_body: The old key stops working now: {name} finds nothing in Lodestar until you paste the new key into it.
settings_outputs_regenerated: Regenerated the key for {name}. Paste the new key into the app.
settings_outputs_revoke_body: {name} stops finding anything in Lodestar. This can't be undone: to use it again, create a new key.
settings_outputs_bitmagnet_intro: Download your torrents as a file that bitmagnet can import. bitmagnet then fetches each torrent's details from the DHT itself.
settings_outputs_bitmagnet_left_out: Always left out: torrents from private sources and private trackers, hidden torrents, unverified ones, and anything blocklisted or removed. Adult torrents are left out unless you include them below.
settings_outputs_bitmagnet_import: To import the file, send it to bitmagnet's import address. For example, with bitmagnet on port 3333 of the same computer:
settings_outputs_bitmagnet_paused: Paused at {done} torrents. Resume it in Jobs.
settings_outputs_bitmagnet_truncated: The file stopped at the limit of {cap} torrents, so it isn't complete.
settings_outputs_bitmagnet_cancelled: The export was cancelled after {done} torrents. The file is incomplete: delete it.
settings_outputs_bitmagnet_failed: The export failed after {done} torrents. The file is incomplete: delete it and try again.
settings_outputs_bitmagnet_lost: Lodestar couldn't find this export's progress. If no file downloaded, check Jobs and try again.
settings_outputs_adult_help: Off by default. This is separate from Show adult content: it decides only what exports include. It applies at once.
settings_outputs_adult_locked: Set by {variable}, so it can't be changed here.
settings_outputs_adult_failed: Couldn't change this setting. Try again.
settings_outputs_adult_body: Exports, including the bitmagnet file, will contain adult torrents, and bitmagnet will look each one up on the DHT.
settings_outputs_adult_age: Only turn this on if you're 18 or older.
settings_outputs_adult_read_only: Lodestar's configuration sets this, so it can't be changed here.
